purpose: Combined freeze, revision, carry, transition, timezone, exception, and derived-parent boundary proof for current SEALED diagnostic source content.

summary.repairRule: availability_precision=date; eligibility=first canonical week_open strictly after availability_date

assertions.expectation: An exact timestamp immediately before the weekly freeze selects the current freeze.
An exact timestamp equal to the weekly freeze follows eligible_at_or_before_freeze.
An exact timestamp after a weekly freeze is not eligible until the next canonical week.
Date-only ALFRED vintages are not eligible on a same-date weekly freeze; they roll to the first strictly later canonical freeze.
No selected rate vintage has a vintage date after the weekly freeze date.
Revised rate observations appear as distinct vintages so earlier weekly snapshots can retain older content and later snapshots can switch.
Every CPI weekly row is SEALED/non-ACTIVE and carries an explicit revision/rebasing version.
Quarterly CPI rows, including NZD, carry under the release-aware rule without premature stale flags.
AUD CPI does not use monthly rows before the contracted October 2025 transition.
The first available control weeks after the October 2025 AUD transition use monthly CPI parents.
EUR CPI stays EA20 through 2025 observation periods and uses EA21 for 2026 observation periods.
RRP eligibility equals the latest eligibility among rate, current CPI, and lag CPI as represented by the CPI parent snapshot.
The current SEALED diagnostic RRP parent chain remains complete at 10,416 pair-weeks with zero stale or missing rows.
New York source-local release timestamps convert differently across EST and EDT.
Sydney source-local release timestamps convert through AEDT before weekly freeze comparison.
A delayed actual source release must map to a later eligible week than the normal schedule would imply.
